senses.gloss: m. (דכן, cmp. דּוּכָן, דִּכְוָון) an elevated spot in the kitchen or in the bath-house for vessels &c., stand (fixed to the stove or portable).

<cite ref="Tosefta Kelim Kamma 5:8">Ib. 8</cite> <he>ד׳ של אולירין</he> the bathers’ stand.
